quote: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: Both intersecting highways are two-directional: The approach for a left turn must be made in that portion of the right half of the highway nearest the centerline thereof.

activation.condition: driver intends a left turn at an intersection of two two-directional highways

obligation.description: approach in the portion of the right half nearest the centerline of the approached highway
